hypothesis: On the fixed H1ca64-bank cohort, pairwise composite likelihood from repeated noisy labels recovers at least63/64 exact triple90 graphs and introduces zero regressions among the61 banks recovered by the fixed posterior equality estimator. Assess the targets separately.
motivation: H1cb proves all3 remaining posterior failures strictly prefer a wrong feasible graph, and the post-run rounding bound shows removing integer rounding cannot restore truth. Test a scientifically different objective: product-marginal posterior equality expectation is a linear surrogate, whereas an edge asserts that its two clean labels differ. High-confidence collisions should receive the nonlinear log penalty implied by that pair model.
scope: Reuse all64 H1ca query bundles, every bank and both single270/triple90 observation formats. This is an adaptive objective comparison on an examined cohort; no fresh-generalization claim and no change to H1ca or H1cb packages. No new source IDs, labels, noise streams, masks or noisy queries.
pair_model: For each queried cell use the unchanged known nominal3/40 channel and independent uniform latent-digit prior. The existing exact posterior equality probability e is rational. Under an edge prior that is uniform over distinct latent-digit pairs, likelihood(edge)/likelihood(unrestricted)=(1-e)/(8/9). Thus negative log composite likelihood differs from sum[-log(1-e)] by a common coquery constant. Sum over jointly observed rows. Rows and graph edges are not independent in the true structured-board process; this is a declared pairwise composite likelihood, not exact whole-board or whole-graph maximum likelihood.
objective: Cost=round_half_even(1e6*sum_over_coqueries[-ln(1-e)]), using natural log. Omit the pair-independent coquery constant by definition. No Laplace pseudo-observations or exposure normalization. Balanced masks give equal exposure within each arm; objective constants linear in degree do not affect exact curvature before quantization. The comparison still changes the objective and rounding behavior and is not a claim of isolating only one numerical effect.
numerics: Keep exact rational posterior probabilities unchanged. Compute log-cost intervals with directed high-precision arithmetic and correctly rounded logarithm error bounds; accept an integer cost only when the entire certified interval rounds to that integer. Prespecify80-digit working precision and160-digit fallback solely for an unresolved rounding interval, never score/outcome selection. Independently verify with literal likelihood products and higher-precision exact-product log intervals. Gate precision/boundary logic on synthetic values before any cohort scores. If a required cost cannot be certified within this fixed rule/budget, retain the affected arm as unresolved.
controls: All128 new grids use exactly the parent queried observations. Recheck128 archived selected controls: originalsingle27064/64 and fixedposteriortriple9061/64. The new single270 likelihood arm is a prespecified diagnostic control; its Q1 pair likelihood has only same/different observation levels, so the fixed-degree objective is affine in equality count before rounding. H1ca harddecoder51/64 is a clearly labeled inherited reference, not another rerun. BP AdamW outside structural inference and first in tables.
inference: Fresh degree1..40 LPs for each of128 arms; analytic zero, exact-curvature degree1..39 selection and lower-degree ties unchanged. No true degree20, edge count810, or geometry supplied. Fresh single-thread HiGHS, literal half-integral optima and independent exact integer certificates. All128 outputs retained; selected fractional is a resolved failure and uncertified required grid is unresolved.

primary.triple_exact: At least63/64. Lower=known exact, upper=exact+unresolved; support lower>=63, falsify upper<63, otherwise inconclusive.
primary.posterior_regressions: Zero regressions among the61 archived posterior successes. Lower=known resolved failures on those61; upper adds unresolved on those61. Support upper=0, falsify lower>0, otherwise inconclusive. This target is separate from absolute recovery.

diagnostics: All128 selected outcomes/degrees/ties; paired gains/losses versus each archived control; individual fate of all3 parent posterior failures; fixed20/top810; exact cost interval widths and fallback counts; objective gap to truth after fitting only. No tuning by these diagnostics and no selective solver retries.
seed_rule: Actual solver seed=base+41*(2*bank+arm_index)+degree. Expand H1ca/H1bz/H1by/H1bw actual grids and scan all explicit historical seed fields before freeze; no source/mask/noise seed draws.
optimization_plan: Use the finite set of rational equality types induced by one or three9-class observations to precompute certified log intervals. Accumulate per-type integer row counts and vectorize exact posterior dot products. Compare against independent literal probability products on unrelated fixtures; time relevant preparation/scoring paths before freezing the chosen implementation. Keep eight persistent bank workers and record live process CPU/counters.
